verdict.rationale: Replit documents Agent Modes (Free, Power, Max) that let users choose the balance between included allowance, credits, and capability before sending a request. This shows a credit/allowance model is surfaced to users up front, but the evidence never details per-action credit costs or what each plan includes. Missing for 10: per-action credit/token consumption breakdown, plan inclusion/allowance specifics, usage tracking or dashboard evidence, independent corroboration of cost clarity.
